findings.text: the embedded figure's disposition pane prints 0 beside delete as enforced and 0 beside delete as obsolete, both with zero-width bars, so the pane sums to 238 against the 257 its section pane and the table both report; a reader who trusts the figure sees no fully-enforced rule and no obsolete row where the artifact's own table holds 18 and 1, and the two panes of one figure disagree with each other.

the remedies row for the manifest-schema rule pairs tests/test_manifest_declared_schema.py with driving test test_a_mapping_body_under_either_key_is_refused_with_the_shape_message, but that test is defined in tests/test_manifest_measurement_keys_declared.py:72, the cited file neither contains nor imports it, and the log cited for the row (test_manifest_declared_schema.log, 18 passed) therefore cannot show it ran; no gate log for the file that does hold it exists in the run directory, so the enforcement the two classification rows at L295 and L427 rely on names a test that was never run in the foreground.

the remedies row for the worker-liveness dispatch guard leaves the Driving test cell empty, so the three classification rows that name tests/test_dispatch_guard_consults_liveness.py (L184, L204, L204) name no test that drives the refusal, against the header at lines 27 to 29 promising that each of the 42 enforced rows does.

the remedies row for plan-write fencing leaves the Driving test cell empty, so the three classification rows that name tests/test_plan_write_stays_in_the_worktree.py (L293, L420, L485) name no test that drives the refusal, the same gap as the liveness row above.

five classification rows (L344, L470, L609, L617, L623) name tests/test_discard_releases_a_clean_worktree.py as an enforcement and its log (4 passed, EXIT=0) exists in the run directory, but no remedies row cites that file, so the header's promise that every such test's log is cited in the remedies table below does not hold for it even though each of those rows also names the covered worktree_fleet file.

the manifest's evidence_inputs and landing lines report 19 delete-as-enforced and 0 delete-as-obsolete where the fragment's table holds 18 and 1 and the fragment's own header states 18 fully enforced, so the durable summary a coordinator reads without opening the artifact states a disposition spread the artifact contradicts.
